heading.title: Consequences of Marriage Under This Act

article.title: Effect of marriage on member of undivided family.
article.content:
19Effect of marriage on member of undivided family.

Section 19  ·  Chapter IV  ·  page 10 of the Act
The marriage solemnized under this Act of any member of an undivided family who professes the Hindu, Buddhist, Sikh or Jaina religions shall be deemed to effect his severance from such family.
